status_reason: Forge V2 Institutional Pipeline (CERTIFIED): Trades=2, WinRate=50.0%, BaseNet=0.459%, StressNet=0.438%, WF=4/4, EarlyCuts=0, NearTPSaves=1, TPExpansions=0, MC95 DD=0.52%.

atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for XAUUSD (SWING_TRADING). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=3.015, trend_persistence=0.27, mean_reversion=0.73. Learned timeframe weights: W1 (w=+0.250), D1 (w=+0.250), H4 (w=+0.250). Ablation-retained features: liquidity_sweep (w=+0.546), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.278), rsi_momentum (w=+0.166), fvg_impulse (w=+0.010) (pruned/left out by ablation: ema_trend, bos_breakout, sentinel_news_sentiment, pulse_social_sentiment).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for XAUUSD (SWING_TRADING): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=3.015, mean-reversion=0.73). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to W1 (w=+0.250), D1 (w=+0.250), H4 (w=+0.250). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [liquidity_sweep (w=+0.546), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.278), rsi_momentum (w=+0.166), fvg_impulse (w=+0.010)] and pruned [ema_trend, bos_breakout, sentinel_news_sentiment, pulse_social_sentiment].

If primary Tier A/B corroboration weakens or liquidity conditions tighten, the thesis reverts to the null base rate.

penalty_hierarchy.unnecessary_early_stop_counterfactual_pe: If trade stops out early (breakeven or early close) and post-exit price action reaches Major TP without hitting initial SL, charge forgone_tp_r penalty.

mtf_intelligence_and_sensitivity_report.design_rule_enforced: Contextual weighted agreement: trades are evaluated via learned timeframe weights and never rejected solely because all 7 timeframes do not point in the same direction.

data_synchronization_audit.candle_close_semantics: Higher-timeframe values become available only after bar_open + timeframe_duration <= trigger_close.

W1.initial_research_role: Broad market direction, major structure and long-term price zones.

D1.initial_research_role: Daily structure, support/resistance, supply/demand and regime context.

H4.initial_research_role: Intermediate trend, structural changes and developing opportunities.

H1.initial_research_role: Refined directional bias and developing trade setups.

A_Baseline_Frozen_V1_Incumbent.research_question: What does the current frozen V1 strategy do under verified test and cost assumptions?

B_Structure_Based.research_question: Does a market-structure stop and dynamic target improve outcomes?

C_ATR_Based.research_question: Does volatility-adjusted stop/target logic improve robustness?

D_Hybrid_Real_Trader_Dynamic_Reanalysis.research_question: Does combining structure, volatility, and live 3-layer dynamic re-analysis improve results?

E_Sizing_Variant.research_question: Does an alternative sizing method improve risk-adjusted outcomes without increasing permitted risk?

execution_model.spread_accounting_policy: OHLC basis is 'bid'; full spread (1.85 bps base / 3.05 bps stress) applied exactly once per round-turn without double-counting.

transitions.reason: Hypothesis, baseline incumbent snapshot, and immutable experiment contract recorded.
Controlled 60% development training, timeframe/component ablation, and policy search executed.
Chronological walk-forward and untouched 40% lockbox evaluation outputs produced under base and stress costs.
Passed independent holdout validation (Net=+0.917R, StressNet=+0.876R, WF Folds=4/4, MC95 DD=0.52%).

Candidate satisfies Forge V2 certification policy (verified costs, positive lockbox expectancy, positive walk-forward stability, safety boundaries intact, outperforms incumbent). Awaiting explicit deployment approval (Section 10: Certification != Deployment).

stop_loss_invalidation_level_and_reason.invalidation_basis: Hybrid structural swing invalidation (swing_low_16/swing_high_16) bounded by learned 1.2941x ATR14.

thesis_invalidation_and_management_condi.early_loss_cut_condition: Close before SL if drawdown reaches -0.4449R and live 3-layer thesis score drops <= -0.3666 with opposing structure break outside a valid DISCOUNT/PREMIUM bounce zone.
thesis_invalidation_and_management_condi.progressive_sl_fitting_condition: Reduce SL risk starting at +0.759R, ratchet to Breakeven at +0.759R, and fit SL at 25% of peak MFE behind EMA21.
thesis_invalidation_and_management_condi.near_tp_reversal_exit_condition: Bank profit immediately if price reaches >=82% of Major TP and shows rejection wick / momentum stall.
thesis_invalidation_and_management_condi.dynamic_major_tp_expansion_condition: When approaching Major TP with strong continuation thesis, expand Major TP to next H4/D1/W1 swing zone and step SL up to 87% of old Major TP.
